title: Uwucungera Ikimenyetso c'Imana
intro: Imbere cane mu rusengero rweranda, umutima w’umuhezagiro waragaburirwa witwararitswe n’Imana. Uwo muntu yari yagenewe kugira uruhara ruhambaye mu kintu c’igitangaza, akazoba igihe c’ububasha n’ubwenge bwa Allah butagira aho bugarukira. Urugendo rwabo rwahishuye ukuri gukomeye, gutera ingorane ukuntu abantu babona ibintu no gushinga ikimenyetso kidasanzwe ku bantu bose.
clues: Natowe kandi ndasukurwa na Allah hejuru y’abagore bose bo mu gihe canje.
Nashizwe munsi y’uburongozi bw’umuhanuzi w’umugororotsi, uno akaba yaronse ivyo kurya mu buryo bw’igitangaro mu cumba canje c’amasengesho.
Naritandukanije n’umuryango wanje nja mu kibanza c’ibanga kugira ngo nsenge Allah.
Umumarayika yarambonekeye afise ishusho y’umuntu atunganye, azana inkuru y’umuhungu atyoroye, naho nyene nta mugabo nari nzi.
Inyuma y’imibabaro yo kuvyara, narategetswe guhungabanya umutwe w’igiti c’umusukoni kugira ngo nshobore kuronka ivyo kurya bishasha.
Igihe nasubira mu bantu banje ntwaye umwana wanje aherutse kuvuka, barambajije, ariko umuhungu wanje w’uruyoya yaravuze ku gitangaro ari mu nda kugira ngo ankingire.

trial.label: Igerageza/Ivyabaye
options: Gutabwa mu muriro ururumba kubera guhakana ibigirwamana .

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Uguca ibice kw'ikiyaga kugira ngo abantu bajabuke .
Umwana yavuga ari mu nda y'umuvyeyi wiwe
Ihishurwa ry'igitabu c'Imana co kuyobora abantu .
outcome.answer: Umwana yavuga ari mu bwana mu kugwanira umuvyeyi wiwe .

arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَتِ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصْطَفَىٰكِ وَطَهَّرَكِ وَٱصْطَفَىٰكِ عَلَىٰ نِسَآءِ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verse: And [mention] when the angels said, "O Mary, indeed Allāh has chosen you and purified you and chosen you above the women of the worlds. (3:42)
